rules.semantic_labels: Normalize only decorative edge whitespace; match the complete semantic title. Treat adjacent parameter titles and value-only buttons as separate elements unless the observed hierarchy combines them.
rules.foreground_scope: Resolve the current foreground container and element type before reading or acting. Do not infer an accessibility type from visible text; OS choices may be Buttons inside a CollectionView rather than StaticText. Review every remaining interaction, not just the failing line. Multi-selection may use Table Cells containing entity StaticText even when single-selection uses CollectionView Buttons; inspect the actual presenter.
rules.unique_reads_and_actions: Both passive reads and actions use one foreground-scoped match. Observations need a visible frame; actions additionally require enabled/hittable. Never pick the first duplicate. Source IDs may not be exported by native alert fields. For observed nested action wrappers, select direct children of the action container; containing a same-ID element is not proof of uniqueness. Keep hit testing in object readiness, not a literal query predicate. Run check-ui-query-predicates.py before CI.
rules.live_state: Require the expected live data or completed transition. Placeholder, redaction, and element existence alone do not establish readiness. Native empty TextField.value may equal placeholderValue: prove empty input with the shared insertion/full-result helper, not a placeholder-only equality.
rules.keyboard_and_scroll: Use shared keyboard and reveal handling; retain explicit postconditions for optional transient UI. Query keyboard collection existence without reading frame after exists; a disappearing keyboard is the intended closed state and must not produce a missing-snapshot failure.
rules.environment: Check actual fixtures, services, onboarding and dependencies, including simulator team/App ID/bundle consistency and the remote consumer’s shared-data context, before long UI work.
rules.first_failure_evidence: Compare hierarchy, recording and coordinates before changing an interaction; capture remote-process logs during the test because runner cleanup can stop its simulator; retain bounded persistent probes and repair missing diagnostics before another attempt. Compare the terminal failure capture as well as the immediate transition capture; a transient spinner does not prove persistent loading.
rules.failure_classification: Separate app defects, harness defects, environment failures and inspection failures; count repeat attempts.
rules.runtime_warnings: A passed assertion does not dispose of application runtime warnings.
rules.device_evidence: Simulator checks do not prove actual audio, notification delivery, re-signing or device permissions.
